abstract_title: Neutrino and Etheric Fields in the Electroweak Force
abstract: Goodman has proposed the role of Neutrinos (Weak Force) in Biology and Consciousness. Overberg’s Consciousness Neutrino Field Theory (CNFT) proposes that neutrino’s form a field about us that “empowers” life’s processes. This Neutrino Field forms an invisible “unseen realm”. This neutrino field may contain “memory” that records electromagnetic activity that occurs in the physical plane.
